**Install:** `pip install a11yviz` —
[a11yviz on PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/a11yviz/)

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import a11yviz
import inspect

groups = [
    ("plotnine transforms",
     "Composable additions to a plotnine chain.",
     ["theme_a11y",
      "scale_color_a11y",     "scale_fill_a11y",
      "scale_color_a11y_div", "scale_fill_a11y_div",
      "scale_color_a11y_seq", "scale_fill_a11y_seq"]),
    ("plotly transforms",
     "Layout and styling for plotly figures.",
     ["a11y_layout", "a11y_plotly"]),
    ("Alt text",
     "Attach, scaffold, or LLM-draft screen-reader descriptions.",
     ["a11y_alt_text", "a11y_alt_template", "a11y_describe"]),
    ("Palettes",
     "Discrete, diverging, and sequential palettes with WCAG metadata.",
     ["a11y_palette", "a11y_palette_div", "a11y_palette_seq",
      "a11y_palette_info", "a11y_palette_list", "a11y_show_palette"]),
    ("Audits and checks",
     "Multi-criterion figure audit, rubric, and single-aspect checks.",
     ["a11y_audit", "a11y_audit_chart", "a11y_audit_doc",
      "a11y_audit_actionable", "a11y_audit_summary", "a11y_rubric",
      "a11y_check_alt_text", "a11y_check_headings",
      "a11y_check_overlap", "a11y_check_palette", "a11y_check_palette_size",
      "a11y_check_readability", "a11y_check_separability",
      "a11y_check_tabindex", "a11y_plotly_sequences"]),
    ("Shiny and HTML helpers",
     "ARIA labels and live-region announcements for Shiny UI.",
     ["a11y_aria_label", "a11y_announce"]),
    ("Wrappers and utilities",
     "One-shot helpers and resource paths.",
     ["make_a11y", "a11y_alpha_presets", "a11y_text_spacing_ratios",
      "a11y_css", "a11y_css_contents", "a11y_wcag_url", "run_app"]),
]

for header, desc, names in groups:
    print(f"\n## {header}\n")
    print(f"{desc}\n")
    print("| Function | Description |")
    print("|---|---|")
    for name in names:
        obj = getattr(a11yviz, name)
        try:
            sig = str(inspect.signature(obj))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            sig = "()"
        doc = (inspect.getdoc(obj) or "").split("\n")[0]
        print(f"| `{name}{sig}` | {doc} |")
```
